Let \(a=y-x-42\) and \(b=y+x+42\). Then
\[
ab=244.
\]
Since \(a,b\) are positive integers of the same parity and \(b>a\), the only valid factor pair of \(244=2^2\cdot 61\) is
\[
(a,b)=(2,122).
\]
Thus
\[
y-x-42=2,\qquad y+x+42=122.
\]
Adding gives \(2y=124\), so \(y=62\). Then \(x=18\). Therefore
\[
x+y=18+62=80.
\]

\[
\boxed{80}
\]
